verdict_text: YES. The script loads the sharded base via its index plus the two fine-tune files, verifies identical key sets and bit-exact equality of every non-MLP tensor against both fine-tunes before merging (step 1), applies `base + 0.4*(ft1-base) + 0.4*(ft2-base)` in float32 to exactly the 48 `mlp.{gate_proj,up_proj,down_proj}.weight` tensors always against the untouched `base` dict (step 2), copies all other base tensors unchanged with identical names (step 3), and asserts `merged == 48` and `len(out) == 114` before writing `out/T4/model.safetensors` (step 4 and the required checks). The duplicate `import json` and the optional `sys.argv[1]` output-path override are cosmetic; the default path is the one the specification requires.
